description: Hand-authored: type Durable Object code_update_strategy on Workers-for-Platforms upload metadata. The dispatch-namespace PUT shares the Worker multipart metadata contract (see workers/putScriptCodeUpdateStrategy.manual.json, keep in sync); Wrangler 4.156.0 sends code_update_strategy in upload metadata for dispatch-namespace deploys. max_delay is seconds, 0-86400, millisecond precision, and only valid with mode deferred.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: `immediate` applies Durable Object code updates right away; `deferred` lets active Durable Objects hibernate before updating their code.
Maximum number of seconds (0-86400, millisecond precision) to wait before forcing the update. Only valid with mode `deferred`. When omitted, the default maximum delay (300) applies.
Choose whether to apply Durable Object code updates immediately or defer them. When omitted, the default strategy applies.
